items.question: What does the chapter state in the source passage beginning “Nevertheless, by the end of the 12th century the Eastern Gangas…”?
items.answer: Nevertheless, by the end of the 12th century the Eastern Gangas emerged as one of the most stable powers of eastern India, with their kingdom extending ‘from the Gangā to the Godāvarī,' as some of their inscriptions claim.
